alpha_world.field_rule: a palette value is field-like when its largest same-value four-connected component has area at least 2*max(height,width)
alpha_world.object_rule: four-connected components over the complement of field-like palette values, permitting adjacent non-field values to share one object

alpha_judgment.reference_authority: every object ref must resolve in the exact same-observation alpha_world catalog
alpha_judgment.text_authority: prediction, plan_summary, and uncertainty are retained as evidence but have no transport-classification authority

object_role_contract.selector_boundary: selectors are frozen adapter data derived before H92 from the recorded observation and admitted memories; no selector or palette value enters the common judgment kernel

kill_conditions: the object compiler cannot uniquely resolve either frozen selector
any proposal object ref is unknown or belongs to another observation catalog
the actor cannot complete the typed proposal protocol without fallback text classification
the object-linked first stage is below 0.50
target task score is lower than placebo
mean paired composite effect is nonpositive
a complier estimate is emitted under a weak object-linked instrument
claim_boundary: one public game, restored observation, controller class, and evidence-backed adapter contract
the common kernel sees only opaque object refs, path order, authority identities, assignment, cost, and external settlement
the experiment tests construct validity of an internal proposal-response quotient rather than benchmark gain
passing does not establish cross-context transport, adaptive silence, compounding capability, or literature novelty
